phase_name: Close the Series and Answer the Remaining Measurement Questions From the Ledger

objectives.description: Run NO extraction pass; record decision and reason in the ledger
Take fresh read-only accrual-sample readings (coverage, pending, pending_kos.jsonl line count) with timestamp
Verify the fresh reading's five sub-counters sum to stated total
Compute review-queue growth across recorded series plus fresh reading
Record queue growth against 2000-objects/day cap and cap's observed character
Compute per-day transcript accrual rate from Available-on-disk series
Re-run two-filter ratio over every coverage reading including fresh one
Run series-completeness check and record shortfalls
List passes with non-zero extract error counts and state drain-rate exclusions
Name explicit list of stated limitations / unanswerable questions
Record issue/win via issue-record.sh as it arises
